Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J40/J40nB494.xml). Recorded Sayings of Monk Yushan. Yushan Shangsi owns the retained deployment: at the winter solstice runs the calendar's one-yang birth straight into Yunmen's fan — it leaps up to the Thirty-Three Heavens, staves through Sakra's nostril, then comes to Qingyun temple to pay its dues — and asks the assembly to stand witness; they are speechless.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (B/B27/B27n0152.xml). Recorded Sayings of National Master Puji Yulin. Yulin Tongxiu owns the retained deployment: at the rain-prayer has Yunmen walk into the bead-string: the bead leaps up to the Thirty-Three Heavens, strikes Sakra's nostril, a carp of the eastern sea takes one blow, rain like a basin pouring — the dean bows at the stone man's head bark-barking real things, and the master rules tonight it will surely rain.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J26/J26nB188.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Rujiu Ruibai. Senses.Explanation: Yunmen's fan: it leaps up to the Thirty-Three Heavens and staves in Sakra's nostril, a carp of the eastern sea takes one blow, and the rain pours like a basin. The records keep the leap and change the leaper — bead, staff, donkey, gate-king, lantern. The fan saying held up: Yushan Shangsi at the winter solstice runs the calendar's one-yang birth straight into Yunmen's fan — it leaps up to the Thirty-Three Heavens, staves through Sakra's nostril, then comes to Qingyun temple to pay its dues — and asks the assembly to stand witness; they are speechless; Yulin Tongxiu at the rain-prayer has Yunmen walk into the bead-string: the bead leaps up to the Thirty-Three Heavens, strikes Sakra's nostril, a carp of the eastern sea takes one blow, rain like a basin pouring — the dean bows at the stone man's head bark-barking real things, and the master rules tonight it will surely rain; Dahui Zonggao raises Yunmen's saying in his own address and bars wonder-talk: take it not as the dark and marvelous — this only the attested know. The jump with other legs: Baiyu Jingsi sets Yangqi's three-legged donkey leaping up to the Thirty-Three Heavens, turning a turn in the Good-Law Hall and kicking Sakra's jeweled crown to powder — what is the principle? — and raps the whisk; Huiyue Xu, invited to the hall at the festival, raises the staff: the staff-child leaps up to the Thirty-Three Heavens, collides with the dragon king Sagara, slams beneath the Diamond Realm, and knocks Sakra's flower-crown flying, while King Vaishravana reports it is just the festival day in the human world; Baichi Xingyuan under his one blow has the thing that cannot hold it ride the buddha-hall, exit the mountain gate, leap up to the Thirty-Three Heavens and strike Sakra's nostril, till Sumeru totters, the sea waves, and the whole great-thousand world shakes — and he asks the patron if he believes it; Feiyin Tongrong has old Shakyamuni come speaking on the tip of his whisk — riding the buddha-hall, driving the mountain gate into the dew-pillar — and the startled gate-kings of the four heavens leap up to the Thirty-Three Heavens while Sakra takes a blow and the eastern sea's dragon king rages in a sky-change of clouds and pouring rain; Ruibai Mingxue outdoes the narrow-mouthed founder at night: the foundation-stone bloomed, the dew-pillar laughed, the lantern leapt up to the Thirty-Three Heavens and struck Sakra's nostril — Vaishravana in a fury slapped Sumeru, and the eastern sea's dragon king's head ached three days.
